label: Google Sheets: Lookup Rows
description: Finds the rows of a Google Sheets tab whose given header column holds an exact value (resolve an id to its record, check a key is already logged); emits the rows, their row numbers, and whether any matched. The matches come a page at a time: at most `maxRows` from `offset`, and no more than fit the 100 KB a wire carries; `nextOffset` is where the next page starts, and `hasMore` says whether there is one.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The picker grant covers the file it picked.

inputs.name: spreadsheet
inputs.label: Spreadsheet
inputs.placeholder: Pick one, or paste its share link

inputs.name: tab
inputs.label: Tab
inputs.placeholder: Pick a tab, or paste a link with #gid=
inputs.description: The tab to use. Empty: the first tab, whatever its id.

inputs.name: column
inputs.label: Column
inputs.description: Header column to match on (a header row is required).

inputs.name: offset
inputs.label: Skip matches
inputs.description: How many matching rows to skip before this page starts. To read the next page, wire the previous call's `nextOffset` here.

inputs.name: maxRows
inputs.label: Max rows
inputs.description: The most matching rows one page holds. A page also stops early when more rows would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

outputs.name: rows
outputs.description: This page's matching rows, keyed by the header.

outputs.name: rowNumbers
outputs.description: Each of this page's matches' 1-based sheet row number.

outputs.name: found
outputs.description: Whether at least one row of the tab matched, on this page or any other.

outputs.name: nextOffset
outputs.description: Where the next page of matches starts: wire it into the next call's `offset`.

outputs.name: hasMore
outputs.description: True when more rows matched than this page holds.
